To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

two B cell proteins, pp70 and 68, which are tyrosine-phoshorylated after B cell antigen receptor activation, interact with phospholipase Cy and Vav and Grb2 and are likely homologs of the SLP-76 linker protein.
pp70 and 68 interact with Grb-2, PLC, Vav, and SLP-76 in B lymphocytes.
two tyrosine phosphoproteins, with M r values 70,000 (pp70) and 68, 000 (pp68) are identified that interact with GrB2, phospholipease C, and Vav following B cell receptor crosslinking.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular mechanisms by which the B cell antigen receptor (BCR) transduces signals.
identifying and characterizing proteins that interact with PLCγ, Grb-2, and VAV in B lymphocytes.
the identification and characterization of proteins which mediate B cell activation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the B cell homolog of SLP-75 is a protein that has an M r value of 68,000 and that interacts with Grb2 and PLCγ.
pp70 and p68 represent B cell homologue(s) of SLP-75 and SLP-76 respectively.
these data suggest the existence of a protein complex that includes Grb2, Vav, and pp70 and pp 68, which may be a key component in the transduction of B cell antigen receptor signaling.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
pp70 and/or pp68 are likely B cell homologues of SLP-75, a T cell protein that interacts with PLCγ1, Grb2 and Vav.
pp70 and 68 are two novel B cell proteins that bind to PLC and Vav and that they may play a role in B cell activation.
the interaction of Grb2, Vav, and PLCγ with tyrosine-phoshorylated proteins pp68 and pp70 is required for the activation of the B cell antigen receptor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are two tyrosine phosphoproteins that are involved in B cell activation, and these proteins interact with Grb 2, PLC and Vav.
there is a family of proteins that interact with the same proteins, and that these proteins may be differentially expressed in different cell types.
the interaction of pp68 and pp70 with Grb2 and Vav is cooperative and that the SH2 domains of PLC and Vav interact with pp68 and pp68 independently.
